_comment: Allternit shared Slack app — create at https://api.slack.com/apps with 'Create from manifest', then copy the Client ID/Secret (OAuth & Permissions) and Signing Secret (Basic Information) into the cloud-api env: SLACK_CLIENT_ID, SLACK_CLIENT_SECRET, SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET. Field reference: https://docs.slack.dev/app-manifests/ and https://docs.slack.dev/reference/app-manifest/. Request URL / command URL point at the cloud (allternit-cloud-api routes::slack_app): POST https://api.allternit.com/api/v1/channels/slack/events and .../commands.
